age_limit.age_details: Teaching Faculty: 69 Years (Not Exceeding), Senior Resident: 44 Years (Not Exceeding) for Clinical Subjects and 49 years for other than clinical subjects. Age limit relaxable for SC/ST/OBC.
age_limit.details: Teaching Faculty: Maximum age is 69 Years. Senior Resident (Clinical Subjects): Maximum age is 44 Years. Senior Resident (Other than clinical subjects including Laboratory Science subjects): Maximum age is 49 Years. Age limit relaxable for SC/ST (05 Years) and OBC (03 Years).

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS/MD/MS/DNB/PG Diploma/BDS/ MDS/ M.Sc/M.Sc-PhD etc. with relevant experience.
qualification.details: Professor: MD/MS/DNB, In an NBE/DNB Institute- Senior Consultant with minimum 3 year of PG teaching experience. Years of experience must have worked as a PG teacher for minimum 3 year. Associate Professor: MD/MS/DNB, 10 years of work experience; Hospital must be a Govt one; Bed capacity must be 220 or more; Must have worked as Specialist/Medical Officer/Senior Resident etc. Experience from non-teaching hospital also will be accepted. However, the hospital must be a government one. Assistant Professor: MD/MS/DNB, Same as that of Associate Professor, but with 2-year or more experience only. Assistant Professor (PG Diploma): PG-Diploma, PG Diploma candidate must have worked in an NMC/NBE recognized institute in the specialty of Diploma in any position such as Consultant/Specialist/Senior Resident/Medical Officer etc. The total experience must be 6 year or more. For PG Diploma candidates, working experience from non-teaching institute will not be considered. The experience must be in the specialty of Diploma and tenure experience must be 6 year or more.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ESIC Medical College & Hospital Margao Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 22nd September 2026. It is advised to submit your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 32 vacancies announced for these posts. The distribution includes 11 for Professor, 20 for Associate Professor, and 1 for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications include MBBS/MD/MS/DNB/PG Diploma/BDS/MDS/M.Sc/M.Sc-PhD etc., along with relevant experience as specified for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Teaching Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Teaching Faculty is 69 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ESIC Medical College & Hospital Margao Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted via email to the specified official email address. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly mentioned.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for 'All Other categories'. SC/ST/All Female candidates/ESIC (Regular Employee), Ex-Servicemen & PH Candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Professor and Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The Professor post offers a Fixed Basic of Rs. 1,18,500/- plus other allowances. For Associate Professor, the Fixed Basic is Rs. 78,800/- plus other allowances.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on acquired academic credentials and performance in an interview. The interview is a crucial part of the selection process.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST candidates (05 Years) and OBC candidates (03 Years) as per the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
